sections.title: LARP Summer Institute: Computing Introduction (2-year Students)
sections.description: This nine-day session introduces the entering two-year MLA students to digital media as the primary mode of design visual communication. The course provides a short, yet intensive, hands-on inquiry into the production and expression of digital media that is essential for all designers. Through a series of working labs, students learn various software applications and associated techniques to execute precise two-dimensional representations of three-dimensional concepts. Students also learn the Weitzman systems, network basics and computer lab procedures. Course enrollment is by permit only. Please contact landarch@design.upenn.edu.
